'''Bart Robinson''' of Newtown, Pennsylvania, played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000. He helped the director with setup and entered game 2 to stop a bye, finishing 64th.<ref name="ramapo2000">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ RamapoCon II Day 2 Director's Report], Scott Lingrell, DeckTech (13 May 2000).</ref>
